Load functions and packages

Load the packages and other functions that will be used during reorganisation.

source('HS_functions.R')

Load data

Load the raw data

Load the raw data exported from Excel to csv.

path_file = "0Data/B22_dances_with_calibrations.csv"
if(!file.exists(path_file))
{print(path_file, '\nnot found')}
hd = read.table(file = path_file, 
                header = T, 
                sep  = ',')

Inspect data

Exported CSVs sometimes end up with empty rows at the end. Check that the last row contains data.

print(hd[dim(hd)[1],])

Rename variables

Rename some variables with shorter or easier to recognise names. Video names currently include the full path for the user that annotated them these can be simplified to just file name and folder (date recorded).

hd = within(hd, {
  ID = paste0(dancer_id) # individual identifier
  ID_d = paste0(dance_id, "_", 
                time, "_",
                source_batch) # dance identifier
  day = source_batch # this is already in POSIX format
  video_file = file.path(basename(dirname(video_name)), #just the folder
                         basename(video_name)) # and file name
  #clean up information that has been doubled
  rm(list = c('dancer_id', 'dance_id', 'dance_key', 'source_batch', "date",
              "video_name", #should be identifiable from video_file
              "waggle_directions",#split into direction_u  and direction_v
              "start_xy"#split into "start_x" and "start_y" 
              ))
})

Identify factor levels

Some of the character variables could be treated as factors. Inspect the different labels to each to check these are informative.

nm_fact = c( "ID",         
 "ID_d"          ,
 # "dance_key"         ,
 # [4,] "waggle_run"        
 "stimulus"         , 
 # "notes"            , 
 # [7,] "waggle_directions" 
#  [8,] "start_x"           
#  [9,] "start_y"           
# [10,] "start_xy"          
# [11,] "csv_file"          
# [12,] "time"              
# [13,] "date"              
# [14,] "direction_u"       
# [15,] "direction_v"       
# [16,] "video_angle_deg"   
# [17,] "start_frame"       
 # "video_name"        
 "video_file" # avoid printing full path        
# [19,] "annotation_session"
# [20,] "source_batch"
            )
sapply(X = hd[, nm_fact],
       unique
     )

Reformat variables

Reformat variables to factor and numeric. Everything else remains character format by default.

nm_num = c(
 #  "dancer_id",         
 # "dance_id"          ,
 # "dance_key"         ,
 "waggle_run",        
 # "stimulus"         , 
 # "notes"            , 
 # [7,] "waggle_directions" 
"start_x"    ,       
"start_y"     ,      
# "start_xy"          
# [11,] "csv_file"          
# [12,] "time"              
# [13,] "date"              
"direction_u",
"direction_v",
"video_angle_deg",
"start_frame",
 # "video_name"        
"annotation_session"
# [20,] "source_batch"
)
#format factors
for(nm in nm_fact)
{
hd[, nm] = as.factor(hd[, nm])
}

#format numeric
for(nm in nm_num)
{
hd[, nm] = as.numeric(hd[, nm])
}

Add sun location

Set up times

hd = within(hd,
            {
              time_code = mapply(FUN = paste, 
                                 day,
                                 time)#time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
              sast_time =  as.POSIXct(time_code, 
                                      tz = "Africa/Johannesburg", 
                                      format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS")#South African Standard time
              utc_time =  as.POSIXct(sast_time, tz = "UTC")#UTC time
              rm("time_code")#now duplicated
            }
)

Adjust for laptop clock (check this)

Videos recorded on the laptop have time stamps in CET not SAST, so they are one hour behind (South African Summer time is UCT + 2, Central European Winter is UTC + 1). Adjust them by adding one hour before calculating sun position.

hd = within(hd,
            {
              sast_time = as.POSIXct(
                mapply(FUN = switch,
                                 EXPR = stimulus,
                                 vertical = sast_time,
                                 horizontal = sast_time,
                                 deg_10 = sast_time,  
                                 antisolar = sast_time + 60*60, #60 min x 60 seconds
                                 solar = sast_time + 60*60,
                                 sast_time
                                 ),
                tz = "Africa/Johannesburg", 
                format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%OS")#South African Standard time
              #recalculate UTC time
              utc_time =  as.POSIXct(sast_time, tz = "UTC")#UTC time
            }
            )

Inspect experiment times

          xlab = "Local time",

### Estimate sun location

# Hive position
# 25° 34' 19" S, 31° 10' 53" E
#-25.571944, 31.181389


#add sun azimuth
hd = within(hd, 
            {
            sun_az = mapply(
                   FUN = GetSaz,
                   tm = utc_time,
                   lon = 31.181389,
                   lat = -25.571944)
            }
            )

#add sun azimuth
hd = within(hd, 
            {
            sun_el = mapply(
                   FUN = GetSel,
                   tm = utc_time,
                   lon = 31.181389,
                   lat = -25.571944)
            }
            )

print(with(hd, sapply(X = list(sun_az, sun_el),FUN =  summary)),
      digits = 2)
##          [,1] [,2]
## Min.      7.3  2.6
## 1st Qu.  93.2 22.1
## Median  254.9 39.7
## Mean    201.0 44.8
## 3rd Qu. 265.4 76.7
## Max.    351.2 83.9
# Hive position
# 25° 34' 19" S, 31° 10' 53" E
#-25.571944, 31.181389

# Feeder position
# 25° 34' 14" S, 31° 10' 59" E
#-25.570556, 31.183056

# Define coordinates (lon, lat)
hive = c(longitude = 31.181389, 
         latitude = -25.571944)
feeder =  c(longitude = 31.183056, 
            latitude = -25.570556)

# Calculate bearing from hive to feeder
feeder_bearing = bearing(hive, feeder)
print(feeder_bearing, digits = 3)
## [1] 47.4
#add feeder azimuth
hd = within(hd, 
            {
            feeder_az = Mod360.180(sun_az - feeder_bearing)
            }
            )
print(with(hd, summary(feeder_az)), digits = 3)

Format angles

#check angle format

est_err = with(hd, {
    (atan2(y = direction_v, x = direction_u) + pi/2) - rad(video_angle_deg)

subs_20250128 = subset(hd, day %in% "2025-01-28")

for(stim in unique(hd$stimulus))

Calculate dance offset from feeder
